articles.origTitle: El Niño Then and Now
articles.origSummary: A 35-year satellite altimetry record lets scientists hold this year’s El Niño up against its strongest predecessors.

articles.title: NASA Welcomes Press to 2026 von Braun Space Symposium
articles.summary: Journalists are invited by NASA to attend the 2026 von Braun Space Exploration Symposium scheduled from October 26 to 28 at the University of Alabama in Huntsville. The event centers on sustainable lunar exploration and human missions back to the Moon.

articles.title: Hubble Telescope Captures Spiral Galaxy NGC 1827
articles.summary: A photograph released by NASA on October 16, 2026, showcases the edge-on spiral galaxy NGC 1827 using data from the Hubble Space Telescope. Situated approximately 37 million light-years away in the constellation Columba, the galaxy was observed as part of an astronomical survey.

articles.title: Arunachal Pradesh Dam Protests Turn Violent, Injuring Police
articles.summary: Demonstrations against the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Pasighat turned violent Friday night after a 12-hour bandh. Over 40 police officers were injured as crowds set an NHPC facility on fire and looted legislators' homes.
